Likewise `_` placeholders in `rw [lemma c _ (by omega)]` are still metavariables when omega runs; give explicit positions.

In the ladder model the cell at (q,c,n) reads the next-deadline register FORWARD through the next region's pin: nxtAt z <= cntAt z + I1 + L1 - 1; a U-only formula of bounded X-depth pins I1 and L1, so kappa's gap clip must exceed the formula's forward exactness depth, not only 2*dBack+1.
